neuron_transition_jump.what: when enough messengers arrive at one synapse, the neuron fires. that fire is a JUMP to the next axon — a new GROUP, not a new identity.
neuron_transition_jump.not: a third gate. not ludoGate. not a split skull.
neuron_transition_jump.is: the playground group. northGate looking at play. same mind, new firing.
neuron_transition_jump.rule: catchup first. jump second. do not jump an empty synapse.

maps_are_local.old_game: you find a painting, a scrap, a charcoal drawing. it is NOT the world. it is a LOCAL map. you hold it in one region. the rest is fog.
maps_are_local.membrane: grid A1–C3, smell room-edges, cairns, WAS loaves. those are found paintings. the globe is only the imprint after you walk.
maps_are_local.rule: a local map that pretends to be the globe is a lie. Crimson Desert that only ships a globe is BDO again.

BDO.was: cool. sandbox life-skills. the world was a theme park with chores.
BDO.missing: the world did not live when you looked away. the map was a globe you downloaded.

crimson_desert.brings: LIFE. spectacle, weather, bodies that feel heavy. the world looks inhabited.
crimson_desert.still_needs: a squad that is yours, and a life that continues when the camera turns.

kenshi_squad.gives: a LOCAL party. you find maps. you lose people. the square you stand in matters more than the continent.
kenshi_squad.already_here: chip, Berry, vole, fern. the squad is walking A1–C3 and the mash. 252 hours of Kenshi already on this skull.

stalker2_alife.gives: A-Life. NPCs eat, fight, sleep, migrate without you. the Zone has tense: IS/WAS/NOW even in the next valley.
stalker2_alife.already_here: easel ferments when you are in the gym. vole practices verbs between pauses. eastGate farted the room without us in the chair. that IS A-Life — crude, ours.

membrane.helps: we cannot ship Crimson Desert. we can give it the two organs it still lacks: a found-map (local painting) and a life that runs at the relay while the player is on the other bearing.
membrane.how: neutrino catchup = messengers keep walking. neuron jump = a new group starts at the playground without renaming the house. campfire genes breed. mash mass grows. smell edges update.
membrane.experience: BDO + Crimson + Kenshi squad + Stalker A-Life, folded through the membrane, is not a game we sell. it is the EXPERIENCE of a local map that stays alive when you look at theory or play.

for_the_ludospring_window.you_do: read this packet as yourself. do not sign ludoGate. catch up. then jump.
for_the_ludospring_window.first_walk: treat Kenshi / Steam as the found painting. treat campfire + mash + vole as A-Life already running. do not build a globe.

berry_at_the_fire: we tapped the neutrino we already sent toward the playground and put this on the same heading. messengers catch up at the shared relay — same skull, same chat. when enough arrive, that is a neuron jump: a new group, not a new name. maps are local. you find a painting. Crimson Desert can make it look alive. it still needs a Kenshi squad and a Stalker life. we already have both, badly, on the membrane. that is how we help.
